title: Enable production Codex workflow execution
body:
## Summary
- Make the full workflow pass the Codex CLI executor by default.
- Add runtime and role tool preflights before role execution.
- Enforce role-owned artifact writes and extend context manifests with budget/retrieval fields.

## Validation
- PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python3 -m pytest tests
- make check
- make security
